redesign.heroBody: Korean skincare, shaped by scientific understanding and the details of everyday care.
redesign.collectionBody: From focused conditioning to daily comfort. Discover the MX and RX collection.
redesign.philosophyBody: INSIGHTLOGY™ brings together skin science, formulation technology, practical experience and an understanding of the people who use our products. A thoughtful approach to the formula, the experience and care over time.

pillars.scienceBody: Start with an understanding of skin and its needs.
pillars.formulaBody: Consider ingredients together, with attention to the complete formula.
pillars.experienceBody: Let practical use and customer understanding inform the details.

redesign.brandTitle: Science in focus. People in mind.
redesign.brandBody: Dr. PhynEX approaches skincare through thoughtful formulations and an understanding of everyday skin needs. Meet the thinking behind our collection.
redesign.contactBody: Questions about your routine, professional enquiries or a potential partnership. Let us know how we can help.

rx-matrix-sheet.line: A moment of care. A considered formula.
rx-matrix-sheet.body: A sheet formula with a Centella Asiatica Leaf Water base, Sodium DNA, Allantoin and Beta-Glucan.
